{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection2","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ReferencedAssemblyEnumFormatter_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> messagePackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n\n        string referencedSource = \"\"\"\nnamespace ReferencedLib\n{\n    public enum ExternalEnum\n    {\n        Alpha = 0,\n        Beta = 1,\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation referencedCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ReferencedLib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(referencedSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            frameworkRefs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = referencedCompilation.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        MetadataReference referencedLibRef = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(peStream.ToArray());\n\n        string consumerSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing ReferencedLib;\n\nnamespace ConsumerApp\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyMessage\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public ExternalEnum Choice { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        MetadataReference[] allRefs = frameworkRefs.Concat(messagePackRefs).Append(referencedLibRef).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ConsumerApp\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(consumerSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            allRefs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol externalEnumSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"ReferencedLib.ExternalEnum\");\n        Assert.NotNull(externalEnumSymbol);\n        Assert.Empty(externalEnumSymbol.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterGenericInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterGenericInterface);\n        INamedTypeSymbol targetFormatterInterface = formatterGenericInterface.Construct(externalEnumSymbol);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> enumFormatters = GetAllNamedTypes(outputCompilation.Assembly.GlobalNamespace)\n            .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(targetFormatterInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default))\n            .ToList();\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol enumFormatter = Assert.Single(enumFormatters);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        Assert.Contains(\n            enumFormatter.GetAttributes(),\n            attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllNamedTypes(INamespaceSymbol ns)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetNestedTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllNamedTypes(childNs))\n            {\n                yield return type;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetNestedTypes(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return nested;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol deeplyNested in GetNestedTypes(nested))\n            {\n                yield return deeplyNested;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
